title: People of Australia’s Commission of Inquiry (Banking and Financial Services) Bill 2017
short_title: People of Australia’s Commission of Inquiry (Banking and Financial Services) Bill 2017

summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: This bill would create a Commission of Inquiry into misconduct in banking and financial services.
The commission would have the same powers as a Royal Commission under the Royal Commissions Act 1902, plus extra powers to protect whistleblowers.
The commission would report to Parliament rather than to the government, and the bill says it would have no financial impact until separately funded.
changes: Establishes a Commission of Inquiry with full Royal Commission powers.
Gives the commission additional powers to protect whistleblowers.
Requires the commission to report to Parliament instead of the Executive.
summary.affected: The banking, financial services and related sectors, including superannuation and insurance providers.
